temporal_state_chain.observed: Ethan notices Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, skipping meals, and sacrificing sleep. He invites Gary to a weekend retreat, but Gary declines, saying he appreciates the concern but has too much to do at the hospital.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was dedicated but was overworking and neglecting his health, and that a relaxing retreat might help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's refusal confirms his work obligations are severe enough that he feels unable to take even two days off, reinforcing Ethan's concern.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is deeply overcommitted and may be unable or unwilling to step away; his health is at risk.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned, worried, and perhaps frustrated or helpless.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary recognize the importance of his health and find a way to support or persuade him toward rest and balance.

temporal_state_chain.observed: During the retreat, Ethan observes that Gary is restless and avoids discussing work.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was severely overworked and health-neglected, with the main barrier being hospital obligations.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's restlessness and avoidance suggest the overworking is not only professional; there may be deeper personal or emotional problems.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is likely hiding a more complicated issue behind his overwork, and he needs a safe opportunity to open up.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Suspicious, worried, and concerned for Gary.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront Gary gently, reassure him, and encourage him to share what is really going on so Ethan can help.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After the confrontation, Gary opens up about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges. Gary agrees to Ethan's suggestion to prioritize tasks and delegate responsibilities.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan suspected Gary's overwork had deeper causes but did not know the details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's disclosure confirms that new-department pressure and personal challenges are driving his overwork.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is overwhelmed by both professional and personal burdens; with practical help, he can begin to find better balance.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To help Gary prioritize tasks, delegate responsibilities, and organize his schedule to make time for himself.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Over the following months, Ethan checks in regularly and sees Gary making efforts to change. Gary reports he is less overwhelmed and even had time for a movie.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary needed ongoing support and practical help to improve his work-life balance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's sustained efforts and reported improvement show the support is working and Gary is changing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is making genuine progress toward a healthier balance and benefits from continued encouragement.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To keep checking in, offering support, and encouraging Gary's progress.

temporal_state_chain.observed: After a year, Ethan sees Gary has successfully adjusted to a healthier work-life balance and can manage on his own. Gary thanks Ethan and says he feels more in control.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Ethan believed Gary was progressing well but might still need regular support or check-ins.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Gary's successful adjustment and independence show he no longer needs active intervention.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Gary is capable of managing his own balance and responsibilities; Ethan can step back while remaining available.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To step back from active support but let Gary know he is always available if needed.
